meta.name: The Detective Is Already Dead
meta.description: After thwarting a hijacking with beautiful, silver-haired detective Siesta, Kimihiko leads a life of globe-trotting and crime-solving—until Siesta dies. A year later, a new case will open old wounds as it threads murder, conspiracy, and his dead partner!

videos.title: Attention Passengers: Is There A Detective on Board? / Commence Adolescent Romantic Comedy
videos.overview: Kimizuka, a middle-school student, meets the beautiful detective Siesta in the process of thwarting a plane hijacking. As they next investigate a mystery at Kimizuka’s school Culture Festival, Siesta urges Kimizuka to become her sidekick.

videos.title: I Still Remember, After All This Time
videos.overview: Kimizuka is approached by Nagisa Natsunagi, a girl with a yearning seemingly inspired by the heart she received in a transplant. When Kimizuka asks Fuubi for help, she takes them to meet an unexpected someone who provides surprising information.

videos.title: That's Yui-nya Quality
videos.overview: A teen idol, Yui Saikawa, enlists Kimizuka and Natsunagi--who has taken up the mantle of legendary detective--to guard a priceless sapphire. In preparing for this, the two realize that more than just a precious jewel is at risk.

videos.title: What I See in That Eye
videos.overview: On the night of Yui Saikawa’s big stadium show, Kimizuka and Natsunagi struggle to protect her from a hidden assailant. But the further the two dig into the plot against Saikawa, the clearer it becomes that the teen idol has secrets of her own.

videos.title: That Was Directed at One Year in the Future
videos.overview: Siesta and Kimizuka investigate a series of murders by someone called Cerberus, who for some sinister reason steals victims’ hearts. As Cerberus eludes Siesta’s pursuit, she comes up with a more desperate tactic, much to Kimizuka’s dismay.

videos.title: Crimson Devil, Ice Queen
videos.overview: Siesta takes an extreme risk to stop Hel and her mutated terror-beast, and pays a price for her courage. The outcome halts the fight against SPES, at least temporarily. In the wake of this battle, Kimizuka makes a surprising discovery in an alley.

videos.title: In Time, You Will Recall this Day
videos.overview: While Siesta convalesces, Alicia takes on the role of substitute detective and seeks the Eye of Sapphire, with Kimizuka’s assistance. When at last Siesta recovers, recovered, the three celebrate, but this celebration takes an unexpected turn.

videos.title: With That, We Set out on a Journey Once Again
videos.overview: Siesta has recovered and is eager to press forward with pursuing the serial killer and SPES. Alicia, however, insists on being involved, and as the two clash and sparks fly, the mystery of Alicia's identity comes more sharply into focus.

videos.title: SPES
videos.overview: In an attempt to rescue Alicia, Siesta, Kimizuka, and Char set off to confront Hel and SPES on their home ground. There, they encounter one alarming surprise after another and come to realize that with SPES, nothing is as it seems.

videos.title: So I Can't Become a Detective
videos.overview: Saikawa, Natsunagi, and Kimizuka set off on a cruise together, during which Kimizuka unexpectedly encounters a former acquaintance. It turns out that something precious is onboard the ship, something which attracts the wrong sort of attention.

videos.title: A Light in the Midst of Hope
videos.overview: Facing off against Chameleon with Natsunagi’s life on the line, Kimizuka finds that he is not alone in this battle, with help coming in unexpected forms. But against this wily foe, Kimizuka’s allies--and his own resilience--are tested to the limits.

videos.title: Those Dizzying Three Years I Spent with You
videos.overview: Siesta, returned in spirit, partners with Kimizuka in a desperate battle against an ever-changing and resilient foe. In the aftermath of this battle, the survivors carry lingering questions and doubts, and must try to find closure amongst themselves.

videos.title: To See You Once More
videos.overview: Kimihiko and his friends are kidnapped as they go to visit Siesta's grave.

videos.title: A Story of That Day No One Knows
videos.overview: Siesta is gone, but Kimihiko and his friends must uncover a new mystery tied to her legacy.

videos.title: An Easy Way to Support Your Favorite by Being an Idol Producer
videos.overview: Saikawa comes to Kimizuka and asks him to be her producer.

videos.title: What We, the Living, Can Do
videos.overview: Scarlet and Bat attempt to recruit Yui.

videos.title: That Was Their Final Answer
videos.overview: Kimizuka battles Charlotte and Fuubi to protect Nagisa.

videos.title: Guardian of the World
videos.overview: Kimizuka and Nagisa travel to look for a clue that Siesta left behind, while Charl and Yui train.

videos.title: Searching for a Single Future
videos.overview: Kimizuka meets Mia Whitlock, a girl who can see the future.

videos.title: On a Moonlit Night, You Make a Vow
videos.overview: Bat helps Saikawa as Kimihiko goes in search of answers at Siesta's old home.
